headline: Brazil Data Center Expansion Depends on Gas Rules and Grid Access
summary: Brazil's data center policy hinges on execution, requiring coordination between parliament and the executive branch. Unlocking hyperscale investment requires new gas rules and grid access under the newly elected Congress.
why: Data center infrastructure investments depend heavily on regulatory stability, energy availability, and governmental policy frameworks in emerging markets.

impacts.why: Regulatory changes and infrastructure investments affect the broader economic environment in Brazil.
